finding: `tasks import --write --reconcile-mirror` can record a `planning-mirror-reconcile` transition in the live ledger while leaving the source planning card frontmatter unchanged, so `tasks status` continues to report live-ledger done vs planning-frontmatter planned divergence.
expectedBehavior: A reconcile-mirror command should either update the authoritative planning mirror, explicitly refuse with a cross-repo write authorization/error, or use an error code that says the mirror was not mutated. It must not emit a done-to-done reconcile transition that implies convergence when divergence remains.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0237, ATM-GOV-0238, and ATM-GOV-0242 after governed close: `node atm.mjs tasks import --from ../3KLife/... --write --reconcile-mirror --json` wrote `.atm/history/tasks/<task>.json` and task-import reports, then `node atm.mjs tasks status --task <task> --json` still reported planningFrontmatter.status=`planned` and residue bucket `stale-import`.
followUp: Add a regression around cross-repo planning mirror mutation and make reconcile semantics transactional: either both live ledger and planning mirror converge, or no reconcile transition is recorded.
